company.name: Lucidya
company.shortDescription: Enterprise B2B SaaS company that aims to reshape customer experience in the MENA region leveraging proprietary AI & NLP technologies.
company.description:
Lucidya is an Enterprise B2B SaaS company that was founded in 2016 with a headquarter in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. In a few years, the company managed to scale its customers base from Saudi to more than 6 countries including leading brands in different industries like Telecoms, BFSI, Automotive, FMCG, Retail, and others

Thanks to its unique and proprietary AI & Arabic NLP technologies, Lucidya provides the most accurate analysis of interactions in the Arabic language making Lucidya the #1 tool in its category by users rating in MENA

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $30,000,000, or 77.76% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $1,331,508, representing 3.45% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,002,642 to $153,586,450, a 51.15x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 80 (-11 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Meltwater.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
